config.sable_beyond.title: %s Configuration
config.sable_beyond.welcome.description:
Welcome to the Sable Beyond configuration page!

Here you can find all available settings for the mod. I have tried to make the config page as clear and user-friendly as possible, and almost every feature can be configured to better match your preferences.

For your information the Dynamic Mass and Entity Mass are now disabled by default...

⚠ This mod is still in alpha, so please make a backup of your world before using it. If you encounter a bug, experience unexpected behavior, or would like to suggest an improvement, the best place to do so is the GitHub Issues page.

Thank you for downloading my mod and supporting Sable Beyond!
config.sable_beyond.other.main_menu: Sable Beyond config button in Main Menu
config.sable_beyond.other.main_menu.tool: Toggles the visibility of the Sable configuration button in the main menu
config.sable_beyond.other.pause_menu: Sable Beyond config button in Pause Menu
config.sable_beyond.other.pause_menu.too: Toggles the visibility of the Sable configuration button in the pause menu
config.sable_beyond.compatibility.create: When a Basin is in an upside-down sublevel, it drops its contents
Toggles whether the Basin's input inventory is emptied when upside down
Toggles whether the Basin's output inventory is emptied when upside down
Ignore Mechanical Arm placement range when sub-levels are involved

If enabled, configuring a Mechanical Arm will keep selected interaction points even when they are outside the normal range, as long as the arm or one of those targets is inside a Sable sub-level. This only affects configuration and does not increase the arm's working range.
Apply Encased Fan airflow force to touched sub-levels
If enabled, Create Encased Fan airflow will apply force to any Sable sub-level that is physically touched by the airflow. This affects server-side physics behaviour.
config.sable_beyond.dynamic_mass.descrip:
The Dynamic Mass system allows to change a block's mass in real time.

 Please note that this feature is still in the testing phase, so expect some bugs.
config.sable_beyond.dynamic_mass.enabled: Global toggle for dynamic block mass overrides.
config.sable_beyond.dynamic_mass.mass_of: Mass of 1 bucket of any liquid in kpg
config.sable_beyond.dynamic_mass.fabric: Sorry Fabric Users that's all, if any idea where to add a liquid dynamic mass or other, please open a Feature issue with ur idea.
Toggles Dynamic Fluid Mass to create %s block
config.sable_beyond.entity_mass.descript:
Entity Mass system allows to give to living entities and item entities a proper mass.

 Please note that this feature is still in the testing phase, so expect some bugs.
Global toggle for all Sable Beyond entity mass features.
config.sable_beyond.entity_mass.experime: Applies the mass system to players. This can be unstable with Sable physics.
Lets players interact physically with sub-levels. Cool, but still experimental.
config.sable_beyond.entity_mass.living_e: Only applies mass to player entities
Toggles mass application for living entities.
Fallback mass used when automatic or formula mass resolution fails.
Automatic mass is collision box volume multiplied by this value.
config.sable_beyond.entity_mass.item_ent: Toggles mass application for dropped item entities.
Formula syntax: operators +, -, *, /, %, ^; functions abs(), sqrt(), floor(), ceil(), round(), min(), max(), pow(), clamp().
config.sable_beyond.entity_mass.living_e: Formula variables: width, height, depth, volume, auto_mass, base_mass, volume_multiplier, health, max_health, age_scale.
Used when the living entity formula is invalid or returns an invalid value.
config.sable_beyond.entity_mass.item_ent: Formula variables: width, height, depth, volume, auto_mass, base_mass, volume_multiplier, block_mass, count, stack_count.
Used when the item formula is invalid or returns an invalid value.
Mass must be finite and non-negative.
sable_beyond.create.mechanical_arm.point: %1$s selected interaction point(s) removed because they are out of range or on a sub-level too far away to be reached by the arm.
%1$s selected interaction point(s) removed because their sub-level is too far away to be reached by the arm.
